item.title: BOOK:ZADIG&VOLTAIRE GRIS - GREY
item.description: The first monograph on Zadig&Voltaire, published on the occasion of the brand's 25th anniversary - English version. Informed by a modern approach to luxury, the brand's signature designs blur the boundaries between masculine and feminine, exuding a rebellious spirit and sense of modern cool. This highly anticipated debut monograph presents Zadig&Voltaire's history through its most memorable collections, advertising campaigns, and iconic moments. Illustrated with evocative photographs captured by some of the most renowned names in fashion photography, such as Inez & Vinoodh and Olivier Zahm, readers discover the influences and inspirations behind Gillier's unique vision. Featuring three different types of paper uncoated for black-and-white photographs; coated for images of design objects; and tipped-in inserts that reproduce the complete text of Zadig across 64 pages, this exceptional piece of bookmaking is a must-have addition to the libraries of fashion aficionados everywhere. - English version - Published by Rizzoli - Date of publication: October 2023 - Hardback - 320 pages - Dimensions: 220 x 305 mm Composition 100% PAPER
